content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-H1, REQ-H2; AC-9

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/llm/dry_run.rs — job runner that replays closed cases through Recommend (no side effects)
- polaris-backend/src/api/llm/admin_dry_run.rs — POST /api/admin/llm/dry-run + GET /api/admin/llm/dry-run/:job_id
- polaris-frontend/src/pages/admin_llm_dry_run.rs
- polaris-frontend/styles/admin-llm-dry-run.css

**Behaviour**:
- Replay each closed case in lookback window
- Record {case_id, would_recommend, human_did, match: bool}
- Aggregate: agreement rate, FP/FN rates, disagreement sample (max 20)
- Policy autonomy-edit blocks `autonomous` until last dry-run ≤ 30d old

**Rust quality**:
- Job state stored in a new dry_run_jobs table; background tokio task with bounded concurrency (reuses classifier semaphore via a separate pool budget)
- No DB writes to observations / actions during replay (verify via the same dispatcher with a `dry_run = true` flag)

**Tests**: tests/llm_dry_run.rs — fixture corpus of 20 closed cases; report shape correct; zero side effects on the cases

**Blocked by**: #LLM-5
